arguments.sql: SELECT 1.0 * SUM(f.is_fraud) / COUNT(*) AS fraud_rate, COUNT(*) AS labelled_swipe_transactions, SUM(f.is_fraud) AS fraud_count FROM transactions t INNER JOIN fraud_labels f ON f.transaction_id = CAST(t.id AS TEXT) WHERE t.transaction_type = 'Swipe Transaction'
arguments.explanation: Returns the fraud rate among labelled swipe transactions, along with the labelled swipe count and fraud count behind it.
assumptions: Only transactions with a fraud label are counted; unlabelled transactions are excluded, not treated as legitimate.
The rate is returned as a fraction between 0 and 1 per the glossary rule; multiply by 100 to read it as a percentage.
The full data period 2019-01-01 to 2019-10-31 is included.
